name: Default
shortDescription: Obsidian Markdown knowledge base desktop app streamed to the browser behind a password, with vaults, settings and plugins kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets passwordless sudo inside the container. Create vaults under /config so they persist.
HTTPS is required; the browser desktop does not work over plain HTTP.
